title: Growth

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Growths are aggressive creatures found in Plains, specifically in Tar pits. They, like Blobs and Oozers, are large, gelatinous piles of sentient tar that emit poisonous black gasses.

table_data.Type: Up to 9 spawn points in Tar pits
table_data.Frequency: 2 respawn every hour, even when the pit is drained

table_data.Type: When a Blob bomb Tar is used

sections.heading: Attack
sections.text: Launches six orbs of tar at the enemy, applying the Tarred and Poison statuses (45 Blunt and 50 Poison damage). Each orb travels at 12 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning and has a spread of 5–20 degrees. This ability can be used when a player is within 15 meters, and it has a cooldown of 8 seconds.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Growths in the tar can be difficult to discern from a distance. Three or more growths may loosely surround the player, dealing high damage.
• They are hostile to other Plains creatures, which makes luring them into Deathsquitos, Fulings or Lox a viable strategy to killing or distracting them. Lox will usually make quick work of them with their powerful AOE attacks.
• Killing them inside the tar pit may result in their loot being stuck

Introduction. Growths are aggressive creatures found in Plains, specifically in Tar pits. They, like Blobs and Oozers, are large, gelatinous piles of sentient tar that emit poisonous black gasses.

Attack. Launches six orbs of tar at the enemy, applying the Tarred and Poison statuses (45 Blunt and 50 Poison damage). Each orb travels at 12 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning and has a spread of 5–20 degrees. This ability can be used when a player is within 15 meters, and it has a cooldown of 8 seconds.

Notes. • Growths in the tar can be difficult to discern from a distance. Three or more growths may loosely surround the player, dealing high damage.
• They are hostile to other Plains creatures, which makes luring them into Deathsquitos, Fulings or Lox a viable strategy to killing or distracting them. Lox will usually make quick work of them with their powerful AOE attacks.
• Killing them inside the tar pit may result in their loot being stuck
